items.title: Study identifies shared genetic links between oral and gastro-intestinal diseases
items.summary: WUHAN, China: Growing evidence suggests that oral and gastro-intestinal diseases are interconnected, but the biological mechanisms underlying these associations are not well understood. A recent large-scale genetic study has examined whether common oral and gastro-intestinal diseases share a genetic susceptibility. items.title: Registration opens for 2027 CDS Midwinter Meeting
items.summary: CHICAGO, US: Registration has opened for the Chicago Dental Society (CDS) Midwinter Meeting, which will return to the McCormick Place West Building in Chicago from 25 to 27 February 2027. The meeting will feature an expanded scientific programme and introduce the Midwinter Meeting Digital Pass, which will provide access to recorded educational sessions.

items.title: Changes to NHS dentistry in Wales – an untested system causing havoc
